Home.h1: Ship agency and marine surveys at the Panama Canal.
Home.sub: Licensed by the Panama Maritime Authority and authorized by the Panama Canal Authority since 2010. One team for the port call. Independent surveyors for the evidence. 24/7.

credentials.acp: Authorized by the Panama Canal Authority
credentials.label: Credentials

Home.servicesTitle: What we do at both ends of the Canal
Home.servicesSub: Seven services, one accountable team for the port call, and independent surveyors for the evidence. Nominate us for the transit; the survey and the fuel are the same phone call.
Home.processTitle: How a port call works with us
Home.processSub: Four steps, each with what you receive and when.

process.title: Nomination
process.text: Send vessel particulars, ETA and the services you need. We confirm receipt with a request number and the duty officer takes it from there.

process.title: Proforma disbursement account
process.text: Canal tolls, reservation fee, fixed tariff, pilotage, tugs, linehandlers and every third-party cost itemized, with the agency fee as one line.

process.title: Boarding and transit
process.text: Our officer boards at the anchorage and coordinates the Authority, pilots, tugs, linehandlers, crew changes and supplies. One WhatsApp thread, one daily update.

process.title: Final disbursement account
process.text: Reconciled line by line against the PDA, every third-party charge with its voucher, variances explained. If a survey came up during the call, its report travels with it.

Home.portsSub: Duty officers on the Pacific and the Atlantic side, and the Panamanian ports we serve.
Home.portsNote: Sample port data; only the ports we actually serve will be published.
Home.captainText: Captain Guillermo A. Peña has commanded and inspected vessels for (years to confirm). He holds the ISM Code Internal Auditor credential, trained at the Seafarers Training Center and Maersk Training Centre, and reviews every survey report that leaves this office.
Home.captainQuote: When you call at three in the morning, you speak with someone who has stood a bridge watch.
Home.whoSub: Different principals, different worries. Tell us who you are and we tell you how we work with you.

who.title: Shipowners & managers

Form.metaTitle: Request a port call or Canal transit
Form.metaDescription: Send vessel particulars, ETA, ports and services. You receive a request number now and an itemized PDA from the duty officer.
Form.title: Request a port call
Form.lead: Two steps: the vessel, then services and contact. You receive a request number on screen and a confirmation by email; the duty officer replies 24/7.
asideItems: You get a request number immediately and a confirmation email.
The duty officer reviews the particulars and prepares the PDA.
Same working day for standard transits, within 24 hours otherwise (to confirm).
Funds are called ahead of transit; the ACP requires them 48 hours before.
Form.attachmentsNote: Attachments (charter party instructions, certificates): reply to the confirmation email with the files. Direct upload is coming soon.
Form.bankNote: Bank details are issued only on the PDA and confirmed by phone with your duty officer. We never change bank details by email.
Form.imoHelp: 7 digits; we validate the check digit.
Form.etaHelp: You can update it later; we plan boarding from your ETA.
Form.draftNote: Nothing is sent until you submit the second step.
Form.notesHelp: Instructions, crew changes, spares, anything the duty officer should know.
Form.consent: I agree to the processing of this data to answer my request (privacy policy).

success.title: Request {number} received.
success.text: The duty officer has it and will reply 24/7. A confirmation was sent to your email. If it is urgent, call {phone}.

errors.imo: IMO numbers have 7 digits and a check digit. Check the last digit.
errors.phone: Use the international format with country code, e.g. +507…
errors.consent: We need your consent to process the request.
errors.form: Something went wrong. Your data is still on this screen: check your connection and send again.
